scripts.db:setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run seed:generate && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.uni-production.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file seed/seed.sql --config wrangler.uni-production.jsonc
scripts.db:update:local: npm run update:generate && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file seed/update.sql
scripts.deploy:legacy: npm run build && node scripts/deploy-client.mjs legacy
scripts.deploy:uni:preview: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run uni:typecheck && npm run uni:build:h5 && node scripts/deploy-client.mjs preview
scripts.deploy:uni:production: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run uni:typecheck && npm run uni:build:h5 && node scripts/deploy-client.mjs production
